name: research-assistant-suite-chatgpt
description: Self-contained research workflow bundle combining methodological planning with evidence-traceable literature search in ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Connect study design with traceable evidence.
interface.longDescription: A self-contained single-entry research workflow that frames a scientific study, runs targeted scholarly evidence work, and returns an evidence-aware next-step decision. It bundles the methodology and literature capabilities while keeping their ownership boundaries explicit.
defaultPrompt: Find evidence for my study question and recommend the next step.
Turn this research idea into a literature-backed study plan.
Compare methods in the literature for my experiment.
